title: Greer's iPhone hacked and threats

tellings.quote: In fact, I just had that happen last week. My iPhone was hacked into and all kinds of stuff. I was threatened.

plain: Steven Greer, a guest who argues that UFO secrets are held by a global cabal, says his iPhone was hacked "just last week" and that he was threatened. He tells Michels this as his own recent experience, offered as a sign that people who push on these secrets are watched and pressured.
